seo_desc: Protect your servers and monetize your data. We implement secure API Gateways to scale and monetize B2B integrations without crashes or hacks.
author_pitch: As a Cloud Specialist, I see companies giving away their most valuable asset: data. Opening your systems to third parties without a security layer is inviting disaster. I design API Gateway architectures that block abuse, control traffic, and allow you to charge per request, turning your code into a billing machine.
title: The black hole of your integrations: Secure and monetize your B2B API
body:
Are your servers crashing when B2B clients connect their systems to your API, or are you giving away massive data uncontrollably?

You took the big step of opening your platform so other companies could integrate with you. But soon the nightmare begins: a client programs their connection poorly and sends you thousands of requests per second, saturating your databases and bringing the service down for everyone else. Furthermore, competitors or bots could be scraping your valuable information without limits. You are assuming enormous cloud infrastructure costs (AWS, Google Cloud) to support third-party traffic, but you are not charging a single cent for that massive consumption of your resources.

The trap of the Unfiltered Open API

Many developers build integrations (endpoints) directly connected to the core logic and hand them over to clients with a simple password, trusting their good use. Exposing the core of your software without a traffic shield is like leaving the safe open in the middle of the street and politely asking nobody to take anything.

Our solution: API Gateway Architecture and Cloud Monetization

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we deploy a smart barrier between your servers and the outside world. We implement advanced API Gateway solutions (like Kong or AWS API Gateway) that act as a high-security toll booth, filtering, measuring, and monetizing every request before it touches your system.

  1. Traffic Control (Rate Limiting): We configure strict requests-per-second quotas for each client, automatically blocking any anomalous spike or DDoS attack without affecting general performance.
  2. Authentication and Military-Grade Encryption: We implement robust security protocols (OAuth2, JWT, and mTLS) to ensure that only authorized and verified machines can access your critical corporate data.
  3. B2B Monetization Gateway: We connect your API consumption with billing systems (like Stripe), allowing you to charge your clients through subscription models or pay-per-call.
  4. Cloud Analytics and Traceability: We deploy real-time dashboards where you can see exactly who consumes your data, which modules are the most used, and where connection errors originate.

The Real Impact on your Digital Ecosystem

  • New Revenue Stream (SaaS): You transform a technical expense into a highly profitable product, charging other companies for automated access to your data and services.
  • Absolute Operational Stability: Your internal servers will never crash again because of external clients, guaranteeing a fast and smooth service twenty-four hours a day.
  • Total Control and Security: You have the power to revoke access instantly, audit consumption, and protect your B2B company's intellectual property against massive extractions and piracy.
